parent_objective: implement a source-diverse protected gate wrapper using M320 corpora and 9944 diagnostic before more PPO

public_gates: implement a reusable source-diverse protected gate wrapper
cover the wrapper with focused tests
validate the wrapper on the M320 replay-sanity setup
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use the wrapper to promote a checkpoint in M322
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: A small source-diverse protected gate wrapper can make the M320 corpora first-class proof gates and reduce manual replay-command errors before more PPO.
success_criteria: wrapper can run multiple boundary_outcome_replay_gate specs and aggregate results
wrapper records 9944 as diagnostic or ingestible artifact
wrapper emits summary JSON/CSV with pass/fail and failure taxonomy
M320 sanity setup reproduces pass results
failure_criteria: wrapper cannot reproduce M320 replay sanity

commands.name: m322_implementation
commands.command: Implement and test source-diverse protected gate wrapper without PPO.

decision_rule: M322 may admit a diagnostic probe only if the wrapper is tested, reproduces M320 replay sanity, keeps 9944 as diagnostic, and does not run PPO.
next_blocker: pending M322 source-diverse protected gate implementation
